random-perks-bingo.puny_target.hint: Click a player: gift them minerals and sic silverfish on them
random-perks-bingo.swap_second.hint: Choose the second player (swaps with the first)
random-perks-bingo.poisoner_target.hint: Click a player to inflict a random debuff for 30 seconds
random-perks-bingo.hodgepodge_target.hin: Click a player to scramble everything in their inventory
random-perks-bingo.lightning_target.hint: Click a player to strike them with lightning
random-perks-bingo.steal_target.hint: Click a player to open their inventory
random-perks-bingo.steal.hint: Click an item to steal it (only once)

random-perks-bingo.message.lightning_no_: No valid enemy nearby to strike.
random-perks-bingo.message.nuke_spawned: Spawned a charged creeper above %s's head!
random-perks-bingo.message.puny_given: Sent %s a humble gift of %s x4 — and some company.

%s climbed onto you! Press Shift 30 times to break free.
random-perks-bingo.message.jockey_thrown: %s threw you off! You cannot ride anyone for 3 minutes.
random-perks-bingo.message.creative_flas: ⭐ Creative Flash! 1.5 seconds of creative mode!
random-perks-bingo.message.mythic_taken: That mythic perk was taken by another player — your choice was rerolled.
random-perks-bingo.message.waypoint_no_d: No death location recorded yet — die once first.
random-perks-bingo.message.waypoint_tele: Teleported to your last death location!
random-perks-bingo.message.waypoint_worl: The waypoint's world no longer exists.
random-perks-bingo.message.village_not_f: No village found nearby — you got a plain compass instead.
random-perks-bingo.message.trader_failed: Could not find a suitable spot to spawn the wandering trader.
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_speed.name: Light Feet
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_jump.name: Spring Legs
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_wind_strid: Move an extra 20% faster while sprinting.
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_tailwind.d: +10% movement speed; +3% more for each other Swift perk.
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_elytra_bon: Your chest slot is permanently bound to an elytra (flight) and grants 2 firework rockets, but movement speed is reduced by 30%.
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_life_bucke: When a fall would be lethal, a water bucket anywhere in your inventory saves you like a totem of undying (only the water is consumed — the bucket stays).
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_gura_shark: Gain a Riptide II trident (right-click in water or rain to launch yourself).
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_omnimoveme: Sprint speed in every direction — backwards, sideways and diagonals included.
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_vein_scen: Mining ores has a chance to drop an extra copy (base 8%, +3% for each other Delver perk).
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_xray_visi: Ores within 10 blocks glow through walls; cost: 35% of items you mine with a pickaxe vanish.
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_lucky_dig: Pickaxe mining can drop a random item, chance scaling with the block's required tier (wood 0.1% / stone 0.5% / iron 1% / diamond+ 10%).
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_collector: 40% chance of an extra drop when mining ores or stone; but mining speed is halved (attack speed unaffected).
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_lumberja: Gain an Efficiency III stone axe.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_timber.d: Chopping an un-stripped log has a 5% chance to drop a stripped log of another wood type.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_bounty.d: Gain 32 carrots and a Fortune III hoe.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_bountifu: Whenever you finish eating a food while your hunger bar is full, gain a random positive suspicious-stew effect (2× the vanilla duration).
Eating any food restores 100% more hunger and saturation (hunger rounds up).
+25% damage to monsters (does not affect players).
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_scavenger: 30% chance of extra loot from mobs.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_soul_harv: 10% chance for an extra drop matching the slain mob (e.g. zombies drop iron, ghasts drop ghast tears).
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_marked_pr: The nearest enemy is always marked: their direction, coordinates and distance are shown and their outline glows; +50% speed while within 256 blocks of them.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_greedy_ha: 50% chance of an extra loot drop on kill; but you take double damage from mobs.
Killing any mob instantly restores 2 hunger and 2 saturation.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_headhunte: Permanently +2 max health for each enemy player you kill (caps at +20, kept after respawn).
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_bare_rage: +40% attack damage while wearing no armor.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_supply.d: Gain 16 bread and a water bucket.
Gain an Efficiency II iron pickaxe (only 24 durability left).
Gain a crafting table, 16 logs, cobblestone and torches.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_fire_tem: Gain a blast furnace, a smoker and a campfire.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_enchante: Gain a max-level or treasure enchanted book, then another every 6 minutes.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_quick_en: On pickup, choose one of your items (armor slot, offhand or inventory) and give it a random max-level enchantment.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_poisoner: When acquired, a target picker opens: choose a player and inflict a random debuff for 30 seconds (Slowness / Mining Fatigue / Nausea / Blindness / Hunger / Weakness / Poison / Wither / Levitation / Darkness / Bad Luck).
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_treasure: Open 1~5 random pieces of armor or tools (up to diamond tier, unenchanted).
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_scout.des: Gain a spyglass (the mob or player you aim at is highlighted for 1 minute, visible to your team), a compass and a treasure map.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_pickpocke: When acquired, a target picker opens; choose an enemy player, then steal one item from their inventory (single use).
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_life_visi: All mobs within 32 blocks are permanently outlined through walls (players excluded).
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_ender_cac: Gain an ender chest now, then one every 10 minutes.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_alchemist: Gain a random potion now, then one every 2 minutes.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_cat_aura: Creepers fear you like they fear cats and flee from you; while in water, you get a random fish every 5 seconds.
Gain 16 fire charges: right-click while holding them to launch a ghast-like fireball.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_long_arm: +4 blocks of block and entity interaction range.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_summon_h: Summon a tamed horse with a saddle at your position (50 HP, top-tier jump strength and speed).
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_big_stom: You can keep eating even with a full hunger bar and full saturation.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_yowl.des: Cats no longer fear you and will attack you instead, but killing a cat always drops 3 string.
Summon 2 tamed wolves of your own (50 health, 6 attack — far stronger than ordinary wolves).
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_wandering: Immediately spawns a wandering trader at your feet (with 2 trader llamas).
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_village_c: Gain a lodestone compass pointing to the nearest village.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_call_ligh: When acquired, a target picker opens; choose any player and summon a lightning strike on them; redirected to a nearby lightning rod if present.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_veteran.d: While holding a sword your attack cooldown is always full, sweeping attacks are disabled, and you can right-click to block with the sword for half damage — the full pre-1.9 combat feel.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_easy_nuke: When acquired, a target picker opens; choose a player and a glowing charged creeper spawns above their head and hunts them down.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_homing_bo: Gain a bow. Every 2 minutes your quiver is restocked with 4 tipped arrows of one random potion. Your arrows home in on the nearest enemy within 16 blocks (teammates and your own tamed mobs excluded), and always hit when aimed at a player.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_jockey.de: Right-click any player to climb onto them and take over their movement and view (press Shift to get off); while riding, damage from them is reduced by 75%. They can break free by pressing Shift 30 times — after that you cannot ride anyone for 3 minutes.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_pig_morph: Your attacks turn the target into a pig for 2 seconds (8 second cooldown); a morphed player's pig head shows their own skin, and their view height drops to a pig's.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_big_snowb: Gain 32 snowballs; the ones you throw are bigger (with a matching hitbox), deal 3 damage on hit, and knock the target flying.
random-perks-bingo.perk.mythic_hodgepodg: When acquired, a target picker opens: choose a player and every item in their inventory is randomly replaced with a different item (counts preserved). Globally unique.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_demon_pac: You deal double damage, but you also take double damage from everything.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_pearl_gau: Every attack you make is a critical hit; but swords no longer sweep, and you permanently have Mining Fatigue I.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_random_gr: When acquired, replaces each block in the 3x3 area under your feet with a random block.
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_escape_pla: Taking damage from a living thing grants Speed II and Resistance I for 10 seconds.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_satiation: While your hunger bar is full, you deal 50% more damage; the cost is that you get hungry much faster.
Gain 4 eggs; when your thrown egg hits a non-boss mob, it turns into its spawn egg and vanishes.
Blindness + Slowness IV for five minutes; survive it to get a Nature's Compass and an Explorer's Compass, or die during it and get only a stone axe.
random-perks-bingo.message.lay_flat_miss: Nature's Compass / Explorer's Compass is not installed; this reward was skipped.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_magnet_up: Your item pickup range is increased to 16 blocks, and a trash slot appears in your inventory (click it while holding an item on your cursor to destroy it).
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_shulker_: Gain a shulker box (27 slots of portable storage).
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_temperin: Gain a damaged anvil (one use left), a furnace, and a stonecutter.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_gleaning: Harvesting a mature crop has a 50% chance to drop an extra random seed.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_happy_gh: Summon a Happy Ghast wearing a harness, and gain 4 leads.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_warm_arc: Gain a brush. Brushing a coral block turns it into dead coral and rolls a warm ocean ruins archaeology loot table — 10% of the time the drop is the mineral matching its color (blue→lapis, pink→diamond, purple→amethyst, red→redstone, yellow→gold nugget).
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_swap.name: Swap
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_swap.desc: On pickup, choose two players (yourself included) and swap their positions.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_old_pries: Summon a master cleric villager, but 0–10 of his trades are randomly disabled.
random-perks-bingo.message.old_priest_fa: No room to stand nearby, so the Old Priest could not spawn.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_tnt_throw: Gain 4 TNT. Right-clicking with TNT throws a lit TNT instead of placing a block.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_munitions: Gain 1 end crystal, 4 TNT, 6 fire charges and 8 gunpowder.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_bounty_hu: Killing a hostile mob type for the first time grants 3 gold ingots.

random-perks-bingo.message.version_missi: Random Perks mod not detected — please install the same version as the server and reconnect.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_waypoint: Gain a clock: right-click while holding it to teleport back to your last death location (5 min cooldown, cross-dimension allowed).
random-perks-bingo.perk.mythic_creative_: Instantly gain 1.5 seconds of creative mode! Globally unique — only one player can own it.
The first 3 players you kill suffer forced death drops — their whole inventory is dropped even if keepInventory is on. Your own death also drops your inventory. Globally unique.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_supply_li: Gain a random supply now, then every 2 minutes.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_ender_sup: Gain an ender pearl now, then one every 5 minutes.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_puny.name: Puny!?
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_puny.desc: When acquired, a target picker opens: choose a player, give them 4 of a random mineral, and spawn a silverfish within 5 blocks of them every 6 seconds for 2 minutes.
